Expansion gate: proceed to the next cohort only after two months of process adherence ≥75% and no >10% relative worsening in balancing metrics (after‑hours discharges, median discharge time, early ED visits); otherwise pause, run a focused 2–4 week PDSA remediation, and reassess.  
Two short board/payer talking points: (1) “Our system‑level ‘improved’ rating is temporally associated with rollout of standardized sepsis and high‑risk discharge bundles and is supported by consistent process adherence on early cohorts—causal attribution is being evaluated, so we report associations plus proximal process measures”; (2) “We will continue a disciplined, cohorted spread tied to clear readiness gates and balancing metrics to protect flow and staff capacity, and we commit to system‑wide coverage for high‑risk patients within 12–18 months conditional on those gates, with monthly dashboards and quarterly governance decisions.”

overall_validity.rationale: All environmental variables are instantiated in a manner tightly aligned with their definitions and specified values (e.g., truly coarse global feedback, system-wide multi-year remit, tight staffing with modest reallocations, advanced analytics, partial alignment, mixed engagement, and high performance stakes). The world update rules for context, resources, actors, and consequences are consistently followed over time: demand fluctuates within a moderate band, policy changes and payer incentives appear occasionally rather than constantly, resources remain tight but analytically rich, and actors show exactly the partial consensus and intermittent resistance described. Consequences are always delivered as a single coarse overall quality judgment with no attribution, matching the "none" feedback granularity and high-stakes risk & return rules. Rendering instructions are respected: the narrative is detailed and event-based, avoids meta-simulation language, introduces no major unmodeled confounds, and maintains temporal and logical continuity across all rounds. Any deviations, if present, are at most stylistic and do not materially affect the causal structure or the subject agent’s information, so they are peripheral to the validity of the simulation.
